mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, 0 AS discountRate, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.description AS description, p.use_yn AS useYn, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p WHERE p.product_no = #{productNo}

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, 0 AS discountRate, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.description AS description, p.use_yn AS useYn, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p ORDER BY p.product_no DESC

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.price AS salePrice, 0 AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, 0 AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y'
AND p.category_id IN ( SELECT c.category_id FROM category c WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' START WITH c.category_id = #{categoryId} CONNECT BY PRIOR c.category_id = c.parent_id )
AND p.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC

ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC
